def get_payments_and_journal_entries(account_name, start_date="2024-01-01", end_date="2024-12-31"):
    query = """
    SELECT 
        'Payment' AS entry_type,
        pm.name AS entry_number,
        pm.posting_date,
        pm.party AS customer,
        pm.mode_of_payment,
        pm.paid_to AS account_debited,
        pm.paid_amount AS amount,
        pm.remarks,
        
        -- Check if payment is linked to a Sales Invoice (if null, it's unlinked)
        (SELECT COUNT(*)
         FROM `tabPayment Entry Reference` per 
         JOIN `tabSales Invoice` si ON si.name = per.reference_name 
         WHERE per.parent = pm.name 
         AND per.reference_doctype = 'Sales Invoice'
         AND YEAR(si.posting_date) = 2024
        ) AS linked_to_2024_invoice
        
    FROM 
        `tabPayment Entry` pm
    WHERE 
        pm.posting_date BETWEEN %s AND %s
        AND  pm.paid_to = %s
        AND pm.docstatus = 1  -- Only Submitted Payments
                AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM `tabPayment Entry Reference` per 
            JOIN `tabSales Invoice` si ON si.name = per.reference_name 
            WHERE per.parent = pm.name 
            AND per.reference_doctype = 'Sales Invoice'
            AND YEAR(si.posting_date) = 2024  -- Exclude if invoice date is in 2024
        )

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        'Journal' AS entry_type,
        je.name AS entry_number,
        je.posting_date,
        jea.party AS customer,
        NULL AS mode_of_payment,
        jea.account AS account_debited,
        jea.debit AS amount,  -- Net effect on the account
        je.remark AS remarks,
        NULL AS linked_to_2024_invoice
        
    FROM 
        `tabJournal Entry` je
    JOIN 
        `tabJournal Entry Account` jea ON jea.parent = je.name
    WHERE 
        je.posting_date BETWEEN %s AND %s
        AND jea.account = %s
        AND jea.debit > 0
        AND je.docstatus = 1  -- Only Submitted Journal Entries

    ORDER BY 
        posting_date ASC, entry_number ASC;
    """

    # Ensure the parameters match the placeholders in the SQL query
    values = (start_date, end_date, account_name, start_date, end_date, account_name)
    
    data = frappe.db.sql(query, values, as_dict=True)
    return data
def get_journal_entries_with_debit(start_date, end_date, account_list):
    # Convert account_list into a SQL-friendly format ('Account1', 'Account2', ...)
    account_tuple = tuple(account_list)

    query = """
    SELECT 
        je.name AS journal_entry_number,
        je.posting_date AS entry_date,
        je.remark AS description,

        -- Concatenate all debit and credit accounts into a JSON object {account_name: amount}
        (SELECT JSON_OBJECTAGG(jea.account, jea.debit) 
         FROM `tabJournal Entry Account` jea 
         WHERE jea.parent = je.name AND jea.debit > 0) AS debit_accounts,

        (SELECT JSON_OBJECTAGG(jea.account, jea.credit) 
         FROM `tabJournal Entry Account` jea 
         WHERE jea.parent = je.name AND jea.credit > 0) AS credit_accounts

    FROM 
        `tabJournal Entry` je
    WHERE 
        je.posting_date BETWEEN %s AND %s
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabJournal Entry Account` jea WHERE jea.parent = je.name AND jea.account IN %s AND jea.debit > 0)
        AND je.docstatus = 1  -- Only valid (Submitted) journal entries

    -- Sorting by posting date and journal entry number
    ORDER BY 
        je.posting_date ASC,  
        je.name ASC;
    """
    data = frappe.db.sql(query, (start_date, end_date, account_tuple), as_dict=True)
    return data
    

def get_child_accounts(parent_account):
    child_accounts = frappe.get_all('Account', filters={'parent_account': parent_account})
    child_account_names = [account.name for account in child_accounts]
    Account_to_ignore=['Perte de non paiement - A&S','Amortissement - A&S','Arrondi - A&S','Impot sur revenu + CNSS - A&S','Retenue a la source achat - A&S','T.C.L - A&S','Taxe Loyer - A&S','Timbre Fiscal - A&S','Dépenses non déclarées - A&S']
    accounts_tot=[]
    for iacc in child_account_names:

            
            #Total_Depense = [item for sublist in Total_Depense for item in sublist]
        child_accounts_i = frappe.get_all('Account', filters={'parent_account': iacc})
        if child_accounts_i:
            child_accounts_i_names=[account.name for account in child_accounts_i]
            for ichild in child_accounts_i_names:
                if ichild not in Account_to_ignore:
                    accounts_tot.append(ichild)
        elif iacc not in Account_to_ignore:
            accounts_tot.append(iacc)
            

    return accounts_tot
def get_journal_entries(source_accounts, target_account, start_date=None, end_date=None):
    """
    Retrieves journal entries between source accounts and a target account, filtered by posting date.

    Parameters:
    -----------
    source_accounts : list
        List of source accounts.
    target_account : str
        Target account.
    start_date : str (optional)
        Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
    end_date : str (optional)
        End date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

    Returns:
    --------
    list
        List of matching journal entries as dictionaries.
    """
    accounts_tuple = tuple(source_accounts) if len(source_accounts) > 1 else f"('{source_accounts[0]}')"

    query = f"""
        SELECT 
            je.name AS journal_entry, 
            je.posting_date, 

            jea.credit, 
            jea.debit
        FROM 
            `tabJournal Entry` je
        JOIN 
            `tabJournal Entry Account` jea ON je.name = jea.parent
        WHERE 
            je.docstatus = 1
            AND jea.account IN {accounts_tuple}
            AND jea.against_account = %s
            AND je.posting_date BETWEEN %s AND %s
        ORDER BY 
            je.posting_date DESC;
    """

    return frappe.db.sql(query, (target_account, start_date, end_date), as_dict=True)
    
def get_payment_entries(source_accounts, target_account, start_date=None, end_date=None):
    """
    Retrieves payment entries between source accounts and a target account, filtered by posting date.

    Parameters:
    -----------
    source_accounts : list
        List of source accounts.
    target_account : str
        Target account.
    start_date : str (optional)
        Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
    end_date : str (optional)
        End date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

    Returns:
    --------
    list
        List of matching payment entries as dictionaries.
    """
    accounts_tuple = tuple(source_accounts) if len(source_accounts) > 1 else f"('{source_accounts[0]}')"

    query = f"""
        SELECT 
            pe.name AS payment_entry, 
            pe.posting_date, 
            pe.party, 
            pe.party_type, 
            pe.paid_amount, 
            pe.paid_to,
            pe.paid_from

        FROM 
            `tabPayment Entry` pe

        WHERE 
            pe.docstatus = 1
            AND pe.paid_from IN {accounts_tuple}
            AND pe.paid_to = %s
            AND pe.posting_date BETWEEN %s AND %s
        ORDER BY 
            pe.posting_date DESC;
    """

    return frappe.db.sql(query, (target_account, start_date, end_date), as_dict=True)

def get_related_pay(ipay,ifac):
    pay=frappe.get_doc("Payment Entry",ipay)
    paid_amount=0

    for pay_i in pay.references:
        if pay_i.reference_name==ifac:
            paid_amount=paid_amount+pay_i.allocated_amount
    return paid_amount

date_debut = frappe.utils.add_months(frappe.utils.nowdate(), -3)
date_fin = frappe.utils.add_days(frappe.utils.nowdate(), -1)

data = frappe.db.sql("""
    SELECT
        t.name,
        t.custom_client,
        t.nom_client,
        t.tel,
        t.subject,
        t.custom_type_dintervention,
        t.status,
        t.raison_annulation,
        t.rapport_visite,
        t.starts_on,
        t.secteur,
        CASE
            WHEN LOCATE('retard', LOWER(IFNULL(t.raison_annulation, ''))) > 0
              OR LOCATE('aqua',   LOWER(IFNULL(t.raison_annulation, ''))) > 0
              OR LOCATE('retard', LOWER(IFNULL(t.rapport_visite,    ''))) > 0
              OR LOCATE('aqua',   LOWER(IFNULL(t.rapport_visite,    ''))) > 0
            THEN 'Oui'
            ELSE 'Non'
        END AS autorisation_remise
    FROM `tabTache de travail` t
    WHERE
        DATE(t.starts_on) BETWEEN %s AND %s
        AND t.custom_type_dintervention IN ('Entretien', 'Réparation')
        AND t.status IN ('Open', 'Cancelled')
        AND IFNULL(t.recontacte, '') = ''
        AND IFNULL(t.custom_client, '') != 'Aqua World'
    ORDER BY t.starts_on ASC
""", (date_debut, date_fin), as_dict=True)
